prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long straight platinum silver hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located at the middle of her bust, about 27% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 14%, 34%, 58% and 80% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries Lichtenstein style Ben-Day dots and thick outlines. Her bust carries a large black panther eye on each breast, a luminous gold-green iris with a round black pupil that fully and opaquely covers her nipple and areola, set in sleek jet-black fur with faint glossy rosette markings, long pale whisker lines and a smoky dark eye-ring sweeping outward over the curve of her bust. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Hokusai Great Wave style rolling waves with foam claws and bold linework. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Van Gogh style swirling thick brushstrokes. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out leaf-like shapes. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.

Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a vast stone courtyard of the Forbidden City with a standard-height palace gate, marble steps with waist-high balustrades, empty of visitors, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
